title: 'Sterling Point' Season 2: Everything to know and how to watch Season 1 on Prime Video
summary: The series follows a New York City teen who inherits her grandfather's mysterious island in Canada, uncovering friends, romance, and secrets.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Sterling Point


stars Ella Rubin, Amélie Hoeferle, Jacob Whiteduck-Lavoie, and more.


- Season 1 premiered on August 5, 2026 and quickly became a No. 1 global debut for Prime Video.


- Prime Video has renewed


Sterling Point


for a second season.


---


Grab your bags—we're headed back to Muskoka.


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/what-you-need-to-know-about-prime-video) has renewed


Sterling Point


for a second season, bringing audiences back to the mysterious Canadian island that captivated millions of viewers around the world this summer.


[Everything to know about the 'Fourth Wing' series coming to Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/fourth-wing-series-prime-video)


Amazon MGM Studios is developing a series adaptation of the 'New York Times' best-selling fantasy novels by Rebecca Yarros.


Created, directed, and executive produced by Megan Park (


My Old Ass


), the critically acclaimed drama series debuted on August 5, 2026 and quickly became a No. 1 global debut for Prime Video.


Speaking about the renewal, Park said: “It’s been an absolute joy to see the appreciation and love for the show. We worked so hard to make the show as authentic as possible and to see audiences respond to that has been thrilling. We cannot wait to dive deeper into these characters and deliver the best second season ever.”


## How to watch 'Sterling Point' on Prime Video


[Sterling Point Season 1](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0H49C7NVH?ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_srfd6f9a_1_1_1&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&sr=1-1&pageTypeId=B0H49LFQJM&qid=1787239279921) is available to stream now globally on Prime Video, which is included with an


[Amazon Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) . Season 2 will premiere exclusively on Prime Video in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide.


Prime is available for $14.99 a month or $139 a year in the United States. Check your local Amazon website for information on Prime membership pricing in your region.


Amazon also offers discounted membership options providing the same benefits of a regular Prime membership at only 50% of the cost. Young adults (ages 18-24) and college students can try


[Prime for Young Adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) with a six-month trial, then pay only $7.49 a month, or $69 a year. Qualifying government-assistance recipients can try


[Prime Access](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) for 30 days before paying $6.99 a month.


There are many other benefits to a Prime membership, including fast, free shipping on millions of items and huge savings on exclusive deals and discounts. Not a member yet?


[Start a 30-day free trial today](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) .


## What is 'Sterling Point' about?


Sterling Point


follows 17-year-old Annie Jacobson, who was raised in New York City with her twin brother and loving adoptive father.


Annie's life takes a turn when she inherits her mysterious grandfather's island in Canada. There, she finds new friends, budding romances, and untold family secrets.

Sterling Point


's ensemble cast for Season 1 includes:

Anora

- Amélie Hoeferle (

as Joe

The Body Remembers When the World Broke Open


) as Kate


- Missi Pyle (


Captain Fantastic

## Who makes 'Sterling Point'?


Sterling Point


was created, directed, and executive produced by co-showrunner Park. From Fake Empire, Josh Schwartz and Stephanie Savage also served as executive producers and co-showrunners.


[Prime Video announces further casting for ‘Boys of Tommen,’ a series based on the bestselling books](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/boys-of-tommen-prime-video)


Producers behind ‘The Summer I Turned Pretty,' ‘Twilight,' and ‘Off Campus’ are bringing Chloe Walsh’s romantic drama novels to the screen.


Tom Ackerley and Dani Gorin executive produced for LuckyChap. Amazon MGM Studios, Fake Empire, and LuckyChap are behind the series.
